name: Unity Agent Plugin
summary: Unity's official plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and Antigravity, bundling Unity's curated game-development skills.
description: Ships 33 skill folders, including unity-cli, new-unity-project, UI Toolkit/uGUI, URP, 2D and tilemaps, physics, audio, localization, multiplayer services, Vivox, in-app purchases and LevelPlay. The Unity CLI installs it: `unity setup claude` installs it from Anthropic's official Claude Code marketplace (as unity@claude-plugins-official), and `unity setup codex`, `unity setup grok` and `unity setup antigravity` do the same for those agents. Plugin version 0.1.8-beta. Licensed under the Unity Companion License for Unity-dependent projects. The Unity-Technologies/skills repo points Claude Code and Codex users to this plugin.
